import unittest

from solution import StateSlot


class CallbackError(Exception):
    pass


class StateSlotTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_constructor_and_read_use_deep_copies(self):
        initial = {"items": [[1]]}
        slot = StateSlot(initial)
        initial["items"][0].append(2)
        first_read = slot.read()
        self.assertEqual(first_read, {"items": [[1]]})
        first_read["items"][0].append(3)
        self.assertEqual(slot.read(), {"items": [[1]]})
        self.assertIsNot(slot.read(), slot.read())

    def test_replace_returns_previous_and_stores_copies(self):
        old = {"v": [1]}
        new = {"v": [2]}
        slot = StateSlot(old)
        previous = slot.replace(new)
        self.assertEqual(previous, old)
        previous["v"].append(9)
        new["v"].append(8)
        self.assertEqual(slot.read(), {"v": [2]})

    def test_changed_value_announces_once_with_independent_copy(self):
        received = []

        def callback(value):
            received.append(value)
            value["items"].append("callback mutation")

        slot = StateSlot({"items": [1]}, callback)
        previous = slot.replace({"items": [2]})
        self.assertEqual(previous, {"items": [1]})
        self.assertEqual(received, [{"items": [2, "callback mutation"]}])
        self.assertEqual(slot.read(), {"items": [2]})

    def test_equal_value_does_not_announce(self):
        calls = []
        slot = StateSlot({"a": [1]}, calls.append)
        returned = slot.replace({"a": [1]})
        self.assertEqual(returned, {"a": [1]})
        self.assertEqual(calls, [])

    def test_announce_false_suppresses_callback(self):
        calls = []
        slot = StateSlot(1, calls.append)
        self.assertEqual(slot.replace(2, announce=False), 1)
        self.assertEqual(slot.read(), 2)
        self.assertEqual(calls, [])

    def test_invalid_announce_does_not_change_state(self):
        calls = []
        slot = StateSlot({"x": [1]}, calls.append)
        for bad in (1, 0, None, "yes", []):
            with self.subTest(bad=bad):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    slot.replace({"x": [2]}, announce=bad)
                self.assertEqual(slot.read(), {"x": [1]})
                self.assertEqual(calls, [])

    def test_callback_exception_propagates_after_new_state_is_retained(self):
        marker = CallbackError("failed")

        def callback(value):
            value.append(99)
            raise marker

        slot = StateSlot([1], callback)
        with self.assertRaises(CallbackError) as caught:
            slot.replace([2])
        self.assertIs(caught.exception, marker)
        self.assertEqual(slot.read(), [2])

    def test_none_callback_is_allowed(self):
        slot = StateSlot("old", None)
        self.assertEqual(slot.replace("new"), "old")
        self.assertEqual(slot.read(), "new")

    def test_noncallable_callback_is_rejected(self):
        for bad in (0, False, "callback", [], {}):
            with self.subTest(bad=bad):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    StateSlot(1, bad)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
